tablet_felix: Highly volatile. Day 29 07:22 feedback showed kitchen_table_k1, contradicting my guess of nightstand_b1. Day 28 07:03 also showed kitchen_table_k1. It is consistently on the kitchen table in the early morning. Check kitchen_table_k1 for early morning; bed_b1 for late night.

mug_felix: Inconsistent. Day 28 20:43 feedback showed coffee_table_l1, contradicting my guess of kitchen_table_k1. Day 24 07:29 feedback showed kitchen_table_k1. It is not on the kitchen table in the evening. Check coffee_table_l1 for evening; kitchen_table_k1 for morning.

charger_felix: Inconsistent. Day 28 22:31 feedback showed nightstand_b1, contradicting my guess of wardrobe_b1. Day 27 22:59 feedback showed desk_b1. It is not in the wardrobe in the late night. Check nightstand_b1 for late night; desk_b1 for earlier evening.

glass_felix: Unpredictable. Day 28 22:31 feedback showed nightstand_b1, contradicting my guess of kitchen_table_k1. Day 27 22:59 feedback showed cupboard_k1. It is not on the kitchen table in the late night. Check nightstand_b1 for late night; cupboard_k1 for earlier evening.

razor_felix: Erratic. Day 29 07:00 feedback showed sink_ba_ba1, contradicting my guess of bathroom_shelf_ba1. However, Day 28 07:00, Day 26 07:00, and Day 25 07:11 all showed bathroom_shelf_ba1. It alternates or is unpredictable in the morning. Do not rely on a single spot; check both sink_ba_ba1 and bathroom_shelf_ba1.

book_felix: Inconsistent. Day 27 21:33 feedback showed bed_b1, contradicting my guess of couch_l1. It is not on the couch in the evening. Check bed_b1 for late night; coffee_table_l1 for mid-day and afternoon.

water_bottle_felix: Inconsistent. Moves between living and kitchen table. Day 22 19:12 feedback confirmed kitchen_table_k1. Check kitchen_table_k1 for late evening; coffee_table_l1 for early morning.
